SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.ID, b.TITLE, b.CONTENTS,
-- 썸네일 1개 (SELECT URL FROM BOARD_FILE bf WHERE bf.BOARD_ID = b.ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS thumbnail,
-- 댓글 수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT c WHERE c.BOARD_ID = b.ID) AS commentCount,
-- 좋아요 수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE l WHERE l.BOARD_ID = b.ID) AS likeCount,
b.VIEW_COUNT, b.CREATED_AT, b.UPDATED_AT, b.IS_NOTIFICATION,
u.UUID AS writerUid, u.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, u.PROFILE_URL AS writerProfileImage, u.BIO AS writerBio
FROM BOARD b JOIN USER_INFO u ON u.UUID = b.WRITER_UID
ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE l WHERE l.BOARD_ID = b.ID) DESC, b.ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT b.ID, b.TITLE, b.CONTENTS,
(SELECT URL FROM BOARD_FILE bf WHERE bf.BOARD_ID = b.ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS thumbnail,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT c WHERE c.BOARD_ID = b.ID) AS commentCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_BOOKMARK bm WHERE bm.BOARD_ID = b.ID) AS bookmarkCount,
-- 좋아요수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE l WHERE l.BOARD_ID = b.ID) AS likeCount,
b.VIEW_COUNT, b.CREATED_AT, b.UPDATED_AT, b.IS_NOTIFICATION,
u.UUID AS writerUid, u.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, u.PROFILE_URL AS writerProfileImage, u.BIO AS writerBio
FROM BOARD b JOIN USER_INFO u ON b.WRITER_UID = u.UUID WHERE b.ID = #{id}
SELECT * FROM BOARD WHERE IS_NOTIFICATION = 'Y' ORDER BY ID DESC
